about: Ticket S14-G3 (issue #451, #303 and #307 in part): the guard's replay table. Each row is a command shape the guard refused in session 13 or 14 (or a wall it must keep), with the session it runs in, the folder it runs from, the verdict it must get and the line that justifies it. Placeholders: {MAIN} the main checkout, {WT} a builder's worktree, {CLEAN} and {DIRTY} worktrees holding web/src/acceptance/t1/ (clean, and with a changed file there), {S} a scratch folder, {SHA} an invented commit id. 'pass' means the guard lets it through; a rule name means it refuses with that rule. All are test inputs only; nothing runs them.
